spec_evidence.checked: Cached stripe OAS snapshots (openapi/spec3.json): insights_resources_payment_evaluation_insights lists card_issuer_decline in v2182 (properties: card_issuer_decline, evaluated_at, fraudulent_dispute) and drops it in v2183 (spec-wide token count 4 -> 0; the insights_resources_payment_evaluation_card_issuer_decline schema is deleted). The three records are the parent property plus its model_score / recommended_action projections of one subtree removal. The sibling scorer object (risk_score, recommended_action) exists in both versions.

alternative_data_source: The payment evaluation scorer object (insights_resources_payment_evaluation_scorer: risk_score, recommended_action) is present in both spec versions and remains the supported recommendation signal.

fix.migration_guide: insights.card_issuer_decline was removed from POST /v1/radar/payment_evaluations responses with no direct successor (insights.card_issuer_decline.model_score). Delete reads of the subtree (including .model_score and .recommended_action). If the code branched on the issuer-decline recommendation, evaluate whether the scorer signal (scorer.recommended_action / scorer.risk_score, available in both versions) covers the decision; adopting it changes semantics from issuer-decline modelling to the general risk scorer, so review the branch rather than blindly substituting.
